title: The ‘Furthur’ Bus’s Long, Strange Trip, and Why It’s Returning to San Francisco
summary: Ken Kesey’s psychedelic bus, immortalized in “The Electric Kool-Aid Acid Test,” is preparing for one more run. And to its owners, America sure could use it.
